summary: The main desk screen for Home Base. Only its imports, props and life area list were visible; the desk layout itself was mostly not in the packet.
purpose: Hosts the desk, which lets the user move between rooms and life areas, replay the cat intro, and switch to classic mode.
why: Likely reason: the desk is a visual way to reach each life area.
how: The file imports the store, auth store, the pop-up component, desk drawings and styles, a sound helper and the AI assistant drawer. It declares three callbacks from the parent and five life areas. The rest of the layout, which uses the CORK_SLOTS section, was not in the packet.
inputs: Three callbacks from the parent: replay the cat intro, move to a room, and switch to classic mode. Store and auth data.
outputs: Not visible in the packet beyond the callbacks it can call.
risks: Life area names here differ from the dashboard planet names, so labels may not match across screens. Most of the component was not reviewed.
debug: If the desk does not respond to clicks, check the room and mode callbacks in the parent. If sound does not play, check the sound helper. If a life area label looks different from the dashboard, compare the lists.
